processDescription: 5-axis CNC milling centers provide simultaneous multi-axis interpolation for complex titanium components. The ability to tilt the tool relative to the workpiece surface maintains optimal chip load and extends tool life, critical for difficult-to-machine titanium alloys, specifically for plate. Precision plate for Aerospace, Chemical present unique challenges: Large thin plate (up to 3000 × 1500 × 3 mm) prone to vibration during machining. Vacuum fixture and fly-cutting strategy required.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-spindle (50–70 bar) with coated carbide tooling. Adaptive trochoidal milling paths reduce radial engagement to control heat generation.
flatnessControl: Large surface area prone to vibration. Vacuum fixture with gasket sealing; fly-cutting strategy with < 0.02 mm flatness over 1000 mm.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for CNC milling from plate (or near-net forging), utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
